grain_rationale: row_count is 44721 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so the silver table carries no exact-duplicate rows; invoice_id alone has only 2330 distinct values against 44721 rows so it cannot identify a line on its own, but combining invoice_id with stock_code yields a tuple that uniquely tags each line item within an invoice, and since duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 that tuple fully absorbs the row population with no residual duplicates requiring aggregation, so grain_type is transaction with one derived identifier.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice number such as 489434 with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2330, identifying the parent invoice that groups line items.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Boolean flag with distinct_values false and true and null_rate 0.0, marking whether the line represents a cancellation rather than a sale.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product stock code such as 10002 or 10123C with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 3141, identifying the product on the line.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text product description such as '12 PENCIL SMALL TUBE WOODLAND'; null_rate is 0.005098 so the field is nullable, likely from unmatched or delisted stock codes.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units transacted on the line, ranging from -1395 to 5184 per the profiled min and max with null_rate 0.0; negative values represent returns and the measure is summed across lines.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the invoice line ranging from 2009-12-01T07:45:00 to 2009-12-23T16:58:00 with null_rate 0.0; sample values resolve to whole minutes, so minute is the finest grain the data supports.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Per-unit price ranging from 0.0 to 1998.49 per the profiled min and max with null_rate 0.0, compared and aggregated across lines as revenue input.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Numeric customer identifier ranging from 12346 to 18287 that labels rather than measures; null_rate is 0.300664 so the field is nullable, consistent with unidentified or guest transactions.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Customer country such as Australia or Germany with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 24, describing the geographic origin of the invoice line.

category_description: One row represents a single invoice line item: a product and quantity billed or cancelled on a given invoice at a point in time, as profiled from silver.silver_invoice_lines.
purpose: This mapping declares how the contracted silver_invoice_lines table enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category, stating its grain, time column, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that renders the gold models.
usage: The rendered draft is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the mapping validator and datacontract lint, and then reviewed and edited by a human before the modeling engine consumes it to emit gold models; it is not itself executable.
limitations: The mapping does not filter is_cancellation rows, resolve the 30.0664% null_rate on customer_id, or interpret negative quantity values as returns; it also does not deduplicate beyond the invoice_id plus stock_code identity, leaving any such business logic to downstream consumers.
